section.title: Properties of Equality

div.title: Properties of Equality
div.para: When you add, subtract, multiply, or divide the same quantity from both sides of an equation, you still have equality.

section.para: For equations to be equivalent, inverse operations are used and must be applied to both sides of an equation so it remains balanced.
Inverse operations are operations that “undo” other operations.
Since 3 is being multiplied by \( x \), to solve for \( x \), divide both sides by 3.
section.title: Try It: Properties of Equality
section.para: Denae bought 6 pounds of grapes for $10.74.

div.para: Compare your answer: Your answer may vary, but here is a sample.

list.item: Write an equation for the situation.

solution.para:
Correct! 1.79
STEP 1: Identify the variable.
\(g\): cost for one pound of grapes
Step 2: Write an equation.
\(6g=10.74\)
STEP 3: Solve for g.
Divide BOTH sides by 6.
\(\frac{6g}{6}=\frac{10.74}{6}\)
Step 4: Simplify to solve.
\(g=1.79\)
